maria_finance: Heads-up — Arcadia Compute sent INV-6132 referencing PO PO-45212 but billed to obsolete costcode CC-15. AP routing failed. Anyone seen Arcadia use CC-15 recently?
nate_ap: AP attempted match by PO number PO-45212 and by vendor. Match hit PO but cost center check failed (ours CC-99). System dropped to exceptions. Link: https://ap.redwood.com/exceptions/INV-6132
ap_bot: Automated: Invoice INV-6132 flagged: cost center mismatch (CC-15 -> expected CC-99). Status: EXCEPTION. Action: procurement confirmation or vendor reissue.
maria_finance: Invoice snippet: ```
Vendor: Arcadia Compute
Invoice: INV-6132
Amount: $24,600.00
PO: PO-45212
Billed cost center: CC-15
Line: Dedicated inference reserved nodes - April
```
vendor_bot: Arcadia portal: "Apologies — billing system defaulted to legacy cost center for some accounts. Can reissue on request."
jules_procure: Are these line items covered under PO-45212? If yes, procurement can approve a one-off mapping but we should require reissue for audit.
maria_finance: Confirmed — services match PO lines. GL string: 5402-PLATFORM-INFRA. Proposal: manual code to CC-99, provisional pay, and require vendor to reissue with CC-99 and correct VAT breakdown.
cfo_jay: Agrees with provisional pay to avoid service disruption. But require vendor reissue and copy of reissued invoice within 20 days, otherwise we will offset and escalate.
nate_ap: I can process manual coding and route to @cfo_jay for approval. Will apply temporary flag "TEMP-CC-ADJ" and create AP action ticket.
ap_bot: Automated: Applied TEMP-CC-ADJ. Invoice INV-6132 status: Pending Manual Approval (cfo_jay). AP ticket AP-4987 created.
cfo_jay: Approved manual code to CC-99 and payment under Net-30. Please capture vendor reissue follow-up in FIN-3655.
nate_ap: Done — coded to CC-99 / GL 5402-PLATFORM-INFRA and scheduled payment. Added follow-up FIN-3655 to vendor master: require CC-99 on future invoices and update onboarding checklist.
maria_finance: I'll email Arcadia for reissue and note for vendor onboarding. Closing when reissue received and VAT line verified. :memo:
